scripts.ports:free: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ports=3000,3001; foreach ($p in $ports) { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Write-Host 'Ports 3000 and 3001 cleared.'"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run ports:free && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/web && npm run lint --workspace apps/api
